correctness.rationale: Unique p-adic factorization gives i_p(p^v u)=sum_{a>=1:a-1+nu_p(a)=v}1_{a/p^{nu_p(a)}|u}. Finite residue averages are exactly 1/lcm on p-free u. The v>V tail has density p^{-(V+1)}, establishing every coefficient, total mass and uniform PGF convergence. Nonnegative rearrangement gives (p-1)log(p/(p-1)); the fiber-size/valuation inequality gives the superexponential tail. Positivity of every count uses the cited constructive theorem plus positive congruence density. The exact integer checker was run successfully, but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural probabilistic invariant completes the arithmetic-statistical picture of an inverse-multiplicity question explicitly posed in the 2022 paper: each fiber size has a positive-density occurrence but large sizes are superexponentially rare, and a full effective distribution and exact mean are obtained. It is not a table recomputation or an arbitrary bounded slice.
